The decisive mistake was the Historian_Expert's claim at step 7 that the first citation reference link on Carl Nebel's page points to the MFAH (Museum of Fine Arts, Houston) page.

The Wikipedia text retrieved in steps 1–6 shows reference 1 is "Thieme-Becker", linking to de.wikipedia.org, not to MFAH. The Historian_Expert asserted the MFAH link without checking it against that text. The agents then tried OCR on an MFAH image and failed. The DataVerification_Expert at step 8 repeated the error, even though the code output at step 9 printed `#cite_note-thb-1`, which contradicts the MFAH assumption.
